subject: Your dog's 45-day transformation awaits
preview_text: You've come this far. See what 110+ dogs have achieved and what's next for your pup.
body_paragraphs: 45 days ago, you started something real. Not just a diet, but a promise to your dog for more playtime, less guilt, and a longer life together. Since then, you've tracked meals, hit milestones, and watched your pup's energy climb back up. That's not just progress—that's proof you're the kind of owner who doesn't quit.

Here's what most people miss: the real shift happens after the first 6 weeks. It's not about losing weight anymore—it's about keeping it off and making this a lifestyle. Think of it like your dog's second chapter, where they run farther, sleep better, and you stop second-guessing every treat. You've earned that confidence.

That's why we built the before/after photo timeline. It's not just for the 'gram—it's to show you the streak of small wins that add up. Open PupShape today, snap a new photo, and compare it to Day 1. You'll see exactly how far you've come, and that's the fuel to keep going.
Open PupShape: Dog Weight Loss Plan now and log your dog's weight this week. See the trend line—it's your dog's health in your hands. P.S. Your vet will thank you when you show them the data.
